spec.description: Each temporal slice can be thought of as a histogram of request durations

spec.description: Time between scheduling and execution of event loop callbacks. >10ms consistently indicates event loop saturation.

spec.title: Total number of tasks in the asyncio event loop per container IP
spec.description: Note that this metric contains both tasks which are done and tasks which are cancelled.

spec.title: Service logs
spec.description: Service logs. N.B. info-level health check and metrics logs are removed. Maintainer: MB.

spec.expr: {source_type="docker_swarm_logs", service_name="${deployment}-simcore_${deployment}_${service}"} NOT (log_level:="INFO" AND _msg:"GET / HTTP") NOT (log_level:="INFO" AND _msg:"GET /metrics HTTP")

spec.title: HTTP requests count per HTTP status (last 5min)
